We are looking for someone with strong practical, hands-on experience in performance marketing, paid advertising, SEO and e-commerce management.

This is not just a social media posting role. The candidate must be capable of independently planning, executing, analysing and optimising digital marketing campaigns to generate leads, increase website traffic and drive online sales.

* Social Media Management

Manage Instagram and Facebook accounts.

Plan monthly content calendars and marketing strategies.

Handle reels, posts, stories and promotional campaigns.

Drive organic growth, engagement and brand awareness.

* Meta & Google Ads – Performance Marketing

Independently plan and execute Meta Ads campaigns.

Manage Facebook and Instagram paid advertising.

Set up and optimise Google Search, Display and Shopping Ads.

Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting and retargeting.

Generate quality leads and improve conversion rates.

Track ROAS, CPC, CPL and overall campaign performance.

Manage complete on-page and off-page SEO.

Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

Improve Google search rankings and organic traffic.

Manage Google Business Profile.

Optimise website content, landing pages and product pages.

Manage and maintain the e-commerce website.

Upload products, images, descriptions and pricing.

Manage product categories, collections and listings.

Monitor website performance and customer journey.

Improve conversion rates and online sales.

* Analytics & Growth

Prepare monthly performance reports.

Identify growth opportunities and implement strategies.

Monitor competitors, trends and market developments.

Focus on measurable business growth and return on investment.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

2–4 years of practical digital marketing experience.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager.

Proven experience running Google Ads campaigns.

Strong knowledge of SEO and Google ranking strategies.

Practical experience managing e-commerce websites.

Updated CV.

**About Us**  
Ritzzpay Services LLP builds technology products and applications for fintech, enterprise and public-sector clients.

We are looking for a Senior Mobile Native Engineer to own the native layer of our mobile apps. The apps are built in React Native. You will build the native modules on Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) that connect them to device features, third-party SDKs and security controls. You will work closely with the React Native, back-end and security teams, and support the apps through certification, launch and ongoing releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain native Android and iOS components for the company’s mobile applications
* Build and maintain React Native native modules and integrate third-party native SDKs
* Implement mobile security best practices for secure data storage, authentication and protection of sensitive information
* Ensure app performance, stability and compatibility across devices and OS versions
* Manage app builds, signing, releases and updates on Google Play and the Apple App Store
* Set up and maintain mobile CI/CD, monitoring and crash reporting

* Write clean, tested and well-documented code, and review other developers’ code

* Hands-on experience building React Native native modules and bridging native SDKs
* Experience integrating third-party SDKs in production apps
* Strong mobile security knowledge: Keystore / Keychain, encryption, SSL pinning, root/jailbreak detection, ProGuard / R8 obfuscation
* Experience with permissions, background services, SMS handling and deep links on both platforms
* Experience publishing and maintaining apps on Google Play and the Apple App Store
* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON and secure authentication (OAuth2 / JWT)

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).  
  
Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability  
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale  
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance  
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate  
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries  
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines  
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement  
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team  
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards  
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing  
  
A day in the life  
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.  
  
About the team  
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.title: Product Manager: GenAI & Enterprise Software
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
Techdome builds AI-first products for enterprise clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists work on LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous agents, and workflow automation, alongside scalable enterprise platforms with the integrations, security, and compliance that clients require.
  
  
**Role Summary**
A GenAI demo takes a weekend. A product that survives a compliance review, a budget cycle, and real users takes a PM who knows the difference.
  
  
As Product Manager, you will own each product from the first client conversation through launch and beyond. You are accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the client relationship. You will turn a talented cross-functional team into shipped products by catching unclear requirements, dropped handoffs, and unspoken risks while they are still cheap to fix.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product and scope**

* Convert client vision into clear scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are ambitious but technically realistic.
* Learn each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and translate them into requirements the team can build without guesswork.

**GenAI delivery**

* Work with ML engineers to move LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, safe production systems.
* Define and track production metrics: accuracy, latency, evaluation results, and cost per query.
* Ensure AI features integrate with client systems through APIs and meet enterprise standards for security, data privacy, and uptime.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are clean and nothing is left to assumption.
* Plan team capacity and hold all parties to clear commitments.
* Manage third-party vendors, including LLM and cloud providers.

**Risk, change, and reporting**

* Run structured change control for scope, timeline, and budget impacts.
* Identify and escalate delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data privacy, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
* Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**Requirements**
**Must have**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having shipped at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a clear understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and of JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Technical grounding in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Strong judgment in managing risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with senior client stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practices.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Deep expertise in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Exposure to multiple industries and the curiosity to learn a new one quickly.

**Success Metrics**
**First 30 days:**
Learn Techdome’s delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
  
  
**By 60 days:**
Independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.
  
  
**By 90 days:**
Deliver a key milestone, improve how we run projects, and earn the trust of the team and clients.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Technically demanding GenAI projects across multiple industries.
* Daily collaboration with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A real voice in how projects are planned, run, and delivered.
* Deep expertise-building at the frontier of GenAI.

**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
Reports To : VP / Strategic Data Lead
  
  
**Job Overview**
Own and govern Participant data products across the investor lifecycle, including leads, prospects, clients, households, relationships, onboarding, servicing, and offboarding. Accountable for data quality, governance, adoption, and business value delivery across participant-focused datasets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Data Product Ownership & Agile Delivery
  
  

* Act as the named Data Owner for assigned data products
* Own Jira epics, features, stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog prioritization
* Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and delivery governance
* Define business definitions, metadata, use cases, and data quality requirements
* Own participant, prospect, client, investor, and household master data
* Manage lead-to-prospect-to-client lifecycle data and business rules
* Govern KYC, CIP, suitability, demographic, contact, and segmentation data
* Support client onboarding, servicing, and offboarding processes
* Drive identity resolution, householding, and relationship management capabilities
* Partner with Advisor, Marketing, Service, Operations, and Compliance teams
* Ensure consistency of participant data across CRM and Wealth Management platforms

Data Product Artifacts
  
  

* Maintain Data Product Charter and Canvas
* Create Data Requirement Documents and user stories
* Maintain data catalog, business glossary, and lineage documentation
* Maintain source-to-target mappings and attribute definitions
* Provide KPI reporting and product health dashboards

Governance, Risk & Compliance
  
  

* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Data Governance teams
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, retention, privacy, and access-control requirements
* Support audits, examinations, and governance reviews

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Business, or related field
* 6–10+ years of Wealth Management or Financial Services experience
* Experience in Data Product Ownership, Product Management, Data Governance, or Data Management
* Experience working in large enterprise environments
* Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices

**Preferences**

* Master’s degree
* Experience within the financial or wealth management industry

**Core Competencies**

* Experience with enterprise data governance platforms and catalogs
* Knowledge of regulatory and supervisory requirements in Wealth Management
* Experience supporting advisor, operations, compliance, and client servicing functions

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java with Cloud - AWS
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Software Engineer with strong Java expertise** **and cloud experience** to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will design and build scalable web services, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to delivering robust, high-performance software solutions leveraging modern technologies and cloud platforms.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance web services using Java
* Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate web services seamlessly into web applications

**Requirements**

* Expertise in implementing security best practices, including authentication and authorization using Spring Security and JWT

* Knowledge of web security principles and best practices
* Skills in version control systems such as Git and ADO
* Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (Sprint board, PR, Jenkins, Docker & Kubernetes, etc.)
* Capability to leverage Swing, AWT, JavaFX, and Java Desktop Applications
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with microservices architecture

* Background in Agile development methodologies, with certification in Java programming or related technologies

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Node.js + GraphQL
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Lead Node.js Developer** to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and enterprise-grade solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in modern **JavaScript**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, and cloud technologies, with a strong understanding of frontend architecture, backend services, application security, performance optimization, and software design principles.

As a Lead Developer, you will play a key role in designing technical solutions, mentoring team members, driving architectural decisions, implementing best practices, and delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable applications.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain server-side applications using Node.js and NestJS, writing reusable, testable, scalable, and efficient backend code
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs for frontend services and third-party integrations
* Build secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT and role-based access control
* Integrate external services, APIs, and cloud-based solutions, while implementing logging, monitoring, caching, and error-handling mechanisms
* Optimize API performance and troubleshoot bottlenecks to ensure high availability and responsiveness
* Design and maintain database schemas and data models, working extensively with SQL and NoSQL databases
* Optimize database queries and indexing strategies to ensure data integrity, scalability, and high-performance data access
* Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, leveraging AWS services for hosting, storage, monitoring, and scalability
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline implementation and deployment automation, monitoring application performance and troubleshooting production issues
* Write comprehensive unit tests, ensure high test coverage, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices using tools such as ESLint and SonarQube
* Apply frontend and backend security best practices to prevent and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF/XSRF), and CORS vulnerabilities, including secure JWT token management and authentication workflows
* Design scalable and maintainable software architectures applying SOLID principles and design patterns such as Singleton Pattern, mentor junior and mid-level developers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Managers, Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of professional software development experience
* Proven experience building large-scale applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js
* Expertise in GraphQL for API design and development
* Background in application architecture and performance optimization
* Skills in testing and cloud deployments
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Solution Architect - Azure with AI
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Solution Architect - Azure with AI** to lead the design and delivery of scalable, AI-driven solutions within the Azure ecosystem. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, strong leadership skills, and a passion for building innovative GenAI platforms that align with business goals and long-term architecture strategy.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provide end-to-end technical leadership from solution design to implementation, ensuring alignment with business goals and long-term architecture strategy
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and stakeholders to refine user stories and translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions
* Design and develop architecture blueprints, including system design, integration strategies, and solution components for GenAI platforms
* Lead the development and deployment of RAG-based applications, AI automation solutions, and intelligent interfaces within the Azure ecosystem
* Define and implement best practices for performance, scalability, security, and cost optimization across AI and cloud solutions
* Guide and mentor engineering teams, ensuring high-quality code, adherence to standards, and effective delivery
* Drive integration with enterprise systems using APIs, Microsoft Graph, and other external services
* Contribute to technical decision-making, risk assessment, and mitigation strategies while ensuring successful delivery of complex AI solutions

**Requirements**

* 12-16 years of experience in software engineering
* Expertise in designing and building scalable applications on Azure cloud using Azure Functions, Web Apps, API Management and Azure DevOps
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions including Azure OpenAI, prompt engineering and implementation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) using Azure AI Search
* Background in building and integrating AI-driven applications such as chatbots, automation workflows and NLP-based systems
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep or ARM templates along with strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Solid programming skills in Python or C#/.NET with exposure to frameworks like FastAPI or Web APIs
* Competency in designing unstructured data pipelines including data ingestion, transformation, enrichment and indexing for AI-driven applications
* Understanding of distributed system design, scalability, performance optimization and monitoring using Azure Application Insights
* Familiarity with agentic frameworks, orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel) or multi-agent systems

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Kubernetes or container-based deployments (AKS)
* Exposure to multi-region deployments and high-availability architecture
* Familiarity with SonarCloud or similar code quality tools
* Background in product-based or platform engineering environments

**Location:** Gachibowli, Hyderabad  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 7+ Years

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Tech Lead** with strong expertise in Java backend development, solution architecture, database technologies, and modern AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in designing scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications, leading technical teams, and delivering end-to-end solutions from architecture and development through production deployment and support.

Candidates must have hands-on development experience and should have successfully deployed at least one project into a production environment, including experience handling production support and resolving critical technical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design and develop scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise application architectures.
* Define technical architecture, application design patterns, coding standards, and development best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches.
* Design microservices-based and distributed application architectures.

**2. Java Backend Development**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and RESTful API development.
* Develop robust, reusable, maintainable, and high-performance backend services.
* Implement microservices, API integrations, and enterprise application components.
* Ensure code quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.

**3. Database Technologies – RDBMS & NoSQL**

* Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.
* Design database schemas, optimize SQL queries, and improve database performance.
* Implement efficient data models, indexing, and transaction management strategies.

**4. AI/ML & Agentic AI Solutions**

* Design and integrate AI/ML-powered capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Hands-on exposure to Agentic AI solutions, AI agents, and LLM-based application development.
* Experience with LLM integration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Understand how to integrate AI services with Java-based backend applications.
* Experience with Python backend development is an added advantage.

**5. Technical Leadership**

* Lead technical design discussions and drive architecture and implementation decisions.
* Own technical delivery, code quality, and engineering standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation challenges.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders.

**6. CI/CD & DevOps Integration**

* Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and implementation.

* Actively participate in coding, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

**8. Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide developers and technical team members.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding and architectural standards.
* Support team members in resolving complex technical challenges.
* Promote engineering best practices and continuous improvement.

**9. VAPT & Security Defect Closure**

* Work closely with security and testing teams to address VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing) findings.
* Analyze and resolve application security vulnerabilities.
* Drive timely closure of security defects and ensure compliance with security standards.

jobs.description:
***Ready to shape secure AI and data platforms at enterprise scale?***
----------------------------------------------------------------------

**Why HSBC**
------------

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

HSBC is seeking a Senior Associate Director, Data and Analytics to set technical direction across AI, data and engineering solutions that deliver measurable business value. The role spans strategy, delivery and governance across platforms and products in a highly regulated environment. You’ll establish technical standards and architecture principles that support secure, scalable and reliable systems. Working closely with senior management, product owners and business stakeholders you’ll align technology choices to strategic priorities and outcomes. Success means stronger engineering and delivery practices, well-governed data and AI solutions and consistent compliance with internal standards and external regulations.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own the design, delivery and governance of AI, data and engineering solutions that create measurable business value
* Define and implement technical strategy for AI, software engineering and data platforms across the organisation
* Set technical standards, architecture principles and best practices across AI model development, data governance and secure system design
* Guide engineers, data specialists and AI practitioners to strengthen technical practice and delivery culture
* Solve complex cross-domain problems spanning applications, infrastructure, data pipelines and AI systems
* Partner with senior management, product owners and business stakeholders to align technology choices with strategic priorities and business outcomes
* Review system, data and AI designs to ensure they are secure, scalable, reliable and compliant with internal and external standards
* Embed compliance with GCIO standards, enterprise architecture principles and banking regulations across engineering, AI and data delivery

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Bring extensive experience in senior engineering roles delivering AI, data or modern software platforms
* Demonstrate deep expertise across software engineering, cloud architecture, AI/ML, data engineering, analytics and system design

* Evidence experience setting technical strategy, governing architecture and delivering engineering transformation
* Demonstrate delivery of complex technical programmes across multidisciplinary engineering, data and AI teams
* Apply strong problem-solving across system-wide, cross-functional and high-complexity topics

**Building trusted AI and data platforms**
------------------------------------------

This is a chance to set direction for enterprise platforms that underpin how HSBC builds and governs AI and data solutions. You’ll shape standards, influence technology decisions and help teams deliver secure, compliant outcomes that stand up to scrutiny. If you want your work to translate into practical improvements in productivity and customer value this role offers the scope to do it. Apply to help strengthen the foundations for responsible AI and data innovation at scale.

jobs.title: Manager, Salesforce Development
jobs.description:
**Manager, Salesforce Development**

Business Systems | ECI Solutions Hyderabad | On-site

**Job Title**

Manager, Salesforce Development

**Location**

Hyderabad, India — On-site

**Work Model**

On-site, 5 days per week

**Department**

Business Systems / Enterprise Applications (Internal IT)

**Reports To**

Chief Information Officer

**Direct Reports**

3–6 Salesforce developers and admins (India-based)

**Employment Type**

Full-time, permanent

**Experience**

9–14 years total; 6+ years hands-on Salesforce development; 2+ years leading a development team

**Working Hours**

India business hours with 2–3 hours of overlap with US Central Time

**ABOUT ECI SOLUTIONS**

ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day — a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data, and telephony systems.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a hands-on Manager, Salesforce Development to run ECI’s Salesforce engineering team in India. This is a player-coach role: roughly 50–60% of your time is spent designing and writing code, and the remainder is spent leading people, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and partnering with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

You will own the technical quality of everything the team ships across Service Cloud and Sales/Revenue Cloud, including the integrations that connect Salesforce to our ERP, billing, and support systems, and the Agentforce and Data Cloud capabilities we are rolling out across service and revenue operations.

This role suits an engineer who is still energised by solving hard platform problems but has grown past wanting to be the only person who can solve them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Leadership**

* Own the technical design of Salesforce solutions across Service Cloud, Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud, balancing declarative configuration against custom code and documenting the reasoning behind each choice.

* Set and enforce coding standards, design patterns, naming conventions, test-coverage expectations, and a definition of done for the team.

* Run code reviews as a teaching exercise, not a gate — raise the team’s ceiling, not just the pull request’s.

* Guard against technical debt: governor limit risk, hard-coded IDs, uncontrolled triggers, duplicated automation, and sprawling unmanaged Flows.

* Partner with architects and the US platform team on org strategy, release planning, and Salesforce release readiness (three major releases per year).

**Hands-on Delivery**

* Write and review production Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, and integration code for the most complex and highest-risk work on the backlog.

* Design and build integrations between Salesforce and ERP, billing, CPQ, data warehouse, and telephony platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.

* Lead the build-out of Agentforce agents, Prompt Builder templates, and Data Cloud grounding for internal service and revenue use cases, including the guardrails, testing and monitoring that make them safe to deploy.

* Troubleshoot production incidents, lead root-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes rather than repeat workarounds.

**People and Delivery Management**

* Line-manage a team of developers and admins: goal setting, one-to-ones, performance reviews, growth plans, and certification paths.

* Plan and sequence sprint work with product owners and business stakeholders; protect the team from thrash and make trade-offs visible early.

Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.

You will oversee projects where **ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Copilot, or other AI tools** are utilized. APIs are being embedded into our Java or .NET backends to create intelligent user experiences (such as chat assistants, intelligent document analysis, or automated workflows).

The perfect candidate has a solid technical foundation (preferably a background in software engineering or systems architecture) and holds the strategic mindset needed to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, oversee multi-million dollar budgets, and advocate for modern Agile methodologies.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Act as a highly technical liaison between developers, architects, product owners, and business leaders
* Guide the team through complex project milestones involving Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET Core/C# ecosystems, microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Facilitate discussions around technical debt, code quality, automated testing (unit/integration/E2E), and CI/CD pipeline bottlenecks
* Oversee dependencies and risks associated with hybrid architectures (e.g., migrating legacy .NET Framework or Java EE monolithic systems to modern, containerized cloud environments)

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
* Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
* Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
* Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
* Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
* Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
* Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
* Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
* Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
* Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
* Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
* Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.

  
About the team  
The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.  
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.  
The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 1+ years of supply chain experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a quantitative field (engineering, economics, math, and statistics), business or equivalent
* 4+ years of supply chain experience, or a MBA and 4+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The

You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Governance Functional Business Analyst**
.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The Corporate Governance Functional Business Analyst supports the delivery and continuous improvement of corporate governance processes, controls, data and technology solutions.
  
  
The role works across business and technology teams to understand needs, translate them into clear and actionable requirements, and support successful implementation through testing, business sign-off and controlled release.
  
  
The role holder will be comfortable working with ambiguity, bringing structure to complex problems and progressing work with a practical, can-do attitude. They’ll communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders, and ensure that requirements, decisions, testing outcomes and approvals are documented to a high standard.
  
  
**Experience Using Digital Governance Systems Is Preferred.**
**In this role, you will:**

* Engage stakeholders to understand governance, process, control, data and reporting needs.
* Manage ambiguity by clarifying scope, assumptions, dependencies, risks and impacts.
* Facilitate requirements elicitation and document clear, concise and testable requirements.
* Analyse current- and future-state processes, identifying control gaps, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Work with business, technology, data, risk and control teams to define practical solution options.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, design, testing, approvals and implementation.
* Plan and coordinate testing, document evidence and defects, support retesting and obtain formal business sign-off.
* Prepare release documentation, support manager approvals and contribute to controlled implementation.

**To be successful you will:**

* Have proven experience leading complex requirements elicitation and resolving ambiguous, conflicting or changing needs.
* Have experience producing high-quality process, control, solution and functional-design documentation with minimal rework.
* Be able to assess options across feasibility, risk, constraints, user impact and value and make evidence-based recommendations.
* Have experience defining data and reporting requirements and resolving data quality, privacy and storage issues.
* Have experience designing test strategies, coordinating UAT, maintaining traceability and securing business sign-off.
* Have hands-on experience using Digital Governance tools or systems, including governance workflows, records, reporting, approvals or controls.
* Be able to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies and risks across Agile and/or waterfall environments.
* Have strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including confidence engaging senior leaders and challenging constructively.

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst(BA)
jobs.description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst, you will turn business needs into Salesforce solutions that help our teams manage the client relationships, proposals, and contracts that make clinical research possible. This position plays a key role in requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, and process improvement, ensuring that every change serves the people who use it.
  
  
You will collaborate with project managers, developers, quality assurance teams, and business stakeholders, work within Agile methodologies, and contribute from initial requirements through implementation. Responsibilities include gathering and documenting requirements, designing Salesforce solutions, configuring declarative tools, supporting user acceptance testing, developing change management strategies, and continuously improving how we use Salesforce, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence outcomes.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through well-designed Salesforce solutions and clear, actionable requirements. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Salesforce Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across the Salesforce platform, Agile delivery, and the clinical research business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Requirements Gathering and Analysis: Conduct workshops and interviews with stakeholders to elicit and document detailed business requirements. Create user stories, acceptance criteria, and use cases to communicate requirements clearly to technical teams, and create Visio flows that document new and existing business processes and functionality
* Solution Design: Collaborate with the team to develop comprehensive solution designs that leverage Salesforce capabilities to meet business objectives. Evaluate and recommend appropriate Salesforce features and third-party applications to enhance business processes
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support: Develop UAT plans and test scenarios, and support business stakeholders with test data creation, training, and demos. Analyze UAT results and work with development teams to address any issues
* Salesforce Configuration: Administer a range of declarative solutions in support of sprint work and resolve production issues when needed. Implement and maintain Salesforce configurations that support business requirements
* Process Improvement: Analyze current business processes and identify opportunities for optimization using Salesforce capabilities. Propose and design process improvements that increase efficiency and user adoption
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with project managers, developers, and quality assurance teams to align business needs with technical solutions. Facilitate communication between IT and business units, manage stakeholder expectations, and provide regular updates on project progress
* Change Management: Develop and execute change management strategies that support smooth adoption of new Salesforce features and processes. Create training materials and conduct user training sessions as needed
* Continuous Improvement: Stay current on the latest Salesforce releases and features, assessing their potential impact and benefits for the organization. Proactively suggest improvements to business processes and Salesforce utilization, and mentor junior team members in Salesforce business analysis practices and methodologies

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in business analysis, requirements gathering and documentation, and translating complex business needs into clear, actionable Salesforce solutions
* A proven track record of providing exceptional customer service to stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite leaders, and managing production issues with meticulous attention to detail
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and facilitate decisions across diverse stakeholder groups
* Comfort working with Salesforce declarative tools, Agile methodologies, and tools such as Jira and Visio
* A proactive mindset, a bias for action, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while adapting readily to changing priorities

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Salesforce Administrator Certification
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience with a strong focus on business analysis and solution design
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data model, and business processes, and of the Salesforce security model and best practices
* Understanding of the full sales cycle, from lead generation and request for proposal through the contract lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience delivering Salesforce projects from conception to implementation
* Ability to design and implement solutions using Salesforce declarative tools, such as Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules, and Approval Processes
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and other relevant Salesforce products
* Understanding of Agi…

jobs.description:
**Project Description:**

* The role sits in the Trade Management team focusing on the build out of the in-house strategic cross asset risk platform: SABRE which is the bank's strategic platform for trade processing, valuation and market. It consists in designing and delivering solutions to the users of this platform with an initial focus onboarding new products, driving enhancement solutions, planning project timelines and working with multiple stakeholders such as users and developers to achieve desired outcome.
* As the main focus of the role is on the Trade Data Store (TDS2), experience in trade booking, lifecycling and how a trade prices using static or market data is preferable. This would also require basic understanding of the financial products booked in the trades, with emphasis on FX (swaps, forwards, NDFs, etc) and IR products (eg. Repo and bonds). The role will be required to provide third-level business support for issues in trade replication, and also project enhancements for Front Office traders' requirements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinating with stakeholders from various project teams in Financial Markets, agree timelines and funding, manage all governance requirements in close collaboration with technical development manager
* Coordinating with cross discipline team members to make sure that all parties are on track with project requirements, deadlines, and schedules
* Document Actions from the workshops and assist with the tracking of the deliverables.
* Prepare Gap Analysis, Business Requirements Documents and Project Approval Requests
* Work closely with SME experts in various areas of the business gaining an understanding of their processes.
* Document and raise any Risks and Issues to the Product Owners, Business owners and Program Management.
* Take part in project testing cycles and assist with the preparation of test packs.
* Understand the functionalities of the current systems and process, and come up with requirements for system/process improvements.

**Mandatory Skills Description:**

* 12+ years of experience with business analysis, solution design and end-to-end delivery in the Financial Markets industry
* Must have deep & strong experience in any one of below (mandatory):
* Equities and Fix Income
* Commodities - especially Precious & Base Metals
* FX Options - expert in FXO strategies and Structures
* Some technical background in analyzing or reviewing code changes would be preferable
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Knowledge and experience of Agile development practices
* Ability to work proactively, independently and displays strong initiative.
* Meticulous and upkeep documentation of project artifacts, discussions, risks, functional specifications
* Strong communication and presentation skills with an excellent standard of English are a must.

jobs.title: AS400 Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: AS400 Lead
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **AS/400 Application Specialist** to guide the AI Tools team in building and maturing EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep expertise in IBM iSeries (AS/400) applications, architecture, data organization, coding patterns, development practices, tools, and infrastructure, including RPG III, RPG IV, RPGLE, free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, COBOL, DDS, DSPFs, SQL, Db2 for i, libraries, objects, service programs, display files, printer files, physical and logical files, commitment control, and journaling
* Apply strong knowledge of Db2 for i and SQL-based application analysis, including database relationships, physical and logical files, views, indexes, constraints, triggers, stored procedures, journaling, data quality, and performance considerations
* Conduct application portfolio analysis and evaluate RPG, CL, COBOL, DDS, SQL, and Db2 for i coding patterns; identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code
* Assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identifying dependencies and business rules, tracing data flows, documenting application behavior, and assessing undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive modernization initiatives including RPG refactoring, fixed-format-to-free-format conversion, DDS-to-DDL conversion, Db2 modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Guide the development of AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 9+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL
* Competency in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL
* Background in Db2 for i, including database design, performance tuning, and SQL-based application analysis
* Understanding of IBM iSeries (AS/400) architecture, libraries, objects, service programs, and file structures (physical, logical, display, printer)
* Skills in reverse engineering legacy AS/400 applications, tracing dependencies, business rules, and data flows
* Knowledge of modernization approaches including RPG refactoring, fixed-format-to-free-format conversion, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Familiarity with API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, and cloud integration or re-platforming strategies
* Capability to collaborate with cross-functional and AI-focused teams to enhance tooling accuracy and delivery outcomes
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

* Manage stakeholder relationships across business, operations, and engineering functions

**Requirements**

* 6-9 years of experience in Business Analysis and requirements gathering, including authoring of BRDs and FRDs
* Expertise in Regulatory Reporting across global regimes
* Knowledge of at least one of the following regulatory regimes: CFTC, SEC, or MiFID/MiFIR
* Familiarity with EMEA and APAC reporting regimes such as SFTR, EMIR, or MMSR
* Understanding of APAC regulatory frameworks including MAS, ASIC, HKMA, or JFSA
* Proficiency in OTC and ETD product knowledge
* Strong stakeholder management skills across business, technology, and operations functions
* Capability to lead root cause analysis and translate findings into actionable solution designs

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, ShareFile
jobs.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - a trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI powered applications and experience with agility and ease.

We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **Product Marketing Manager**, and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Learn more about us.

**As a member of our team, you will:**

Be part of an innovative and strategic Product Marketing team that helps drive the business forward. We are not order takers. We bring strong points of view, work cross-functionally, and turn product capabilities into compelling market opportunities.

We’re looking for a **Product Marketing Manager** who can operate as a senior player on the team—someone who can lead strategic projects and high-visibility launches while also managing the day-to-day work required to bring product releases to market. You’ll understand the technical details of our products, what matters most to our buyers, and how to bring our strongest capabilities to market.

We are also an AI-forward team. We look for creative ways to solve problems, work smarter, and drive growth, and we’re not afraid to try new approaches.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own positioning and messaging for the products and solutions you support, translating technical capabilities into differentiated buyer value.
* Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for product launches and releases, aligning Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing around a shared plan.
* Become an expert on our buyers, customers, market, and competitors, using research, competitive intelligence, and win/loss insights to inform strategy.
* Build content and enablement that helps buyers understand our value and equips customer-facing teams to tell our story.
* Partner with Product to understand the roadmap, influence how capabilities are brought to market, and bring customer and market insight into key decisions.
* Use performance data to understand what is working, identify opportunities, and recommend where we should invest or adjust.

**At a more granular level, these will include the following:**

* Developing clear positioning, messaging, value propositions, personas, and competitive differentiation.
* Building and leading go-to-market plans for new products, major launches, and ongoing releases.
* Conducting customer, market, and competitive research to identify buyer needs, emerging trends, and growth opportunities.
* Understanding the customer journey and defining the content, messaging, and experiences needed at each stage.
* Translating complex technical capabilities into simple, credible stories for buyers, customers, and internal teams.
* Enabling Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success with the messaging, tools, and training they need to succeed.
* Partnering with Marketing on campaigns, events, sales plays, customer advocacy, and other programs that drive growth.
* Contributing to pricing and packaging strategy to strengthen our market position and reduce friction in the buying process.
* Using AI and emerging technologies to improve how we research, create, analyze, execute, and scale our work.

**Your background:**

* 4-6 years of experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, or a related B2B technology go-to-market role.
* A proven track record of leading strategic product launches and cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.
* The ability to understand technical products and translate complex capabilities into compelling business value.
* Strong positioning, messaging, storytelling, and communication skills.
* A strategic, business-minded, and customer-centric approach, with the ability to turn research and data into action.
* Strong relationship-building and influencing skills across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
* The ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.
* A creative, resourceful, and action-oriented mindset with a high bar for quality.
* Confidence presenting to internal and external audiences.
* Comfort using AI as part of your day-to-day work and curiosity about new ways to improve speed, quality, and impact.

**If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we’d be happy to chat. What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great** **company culture** **with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with, and also to enjoy:**

**Compensation**

* Competitive remuneration package
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrolment

**Vacation, Family, and Health**

* 30 days of earned leave
* An extra day off for your birthday
* Various other leaves like marriage leave, casual leave, maternity leave, and paternity leave
* Premium Group Medical Insurance for employees and five dependents, personal accident insurance coverage, and life insurance coverage
* Professional development reimbursement
* Interest subsidy on loans - either vehicle or personal loans.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Application Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the application software development lifecycle. Utilizes working knowledge to develop new application features and enhancements following design specifications, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Leads code reviews in designated application areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex application issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Designs and develops application software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined application architecture. Collaborates within and beyond the immediate team to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues, independently. Collaborates with the team to establish and follow application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality. Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Application Software Development:**

* Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes.
* Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts.
* Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes.
* Partners with QA to define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules.
* Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements.
* Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans.
* Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area.
* Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback.
* Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement.
* Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.
* Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.
* Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. **Job Description**
Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own product strategy and the long-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows
* Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand
* Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
* Run front-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
* Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
* Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar

* Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
* Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
* Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
* Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
* Help ensure India-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

* - 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
* - Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure
* Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography
* Familiarity with encryption concepts (message-level and field-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices
* Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
* Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive capabilities
* Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus

You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs.
