jobs.description:
**About KrisAtWork**

Kris@Work is the new generation AI-native Go-To-Market platform. It runs a B2B company's entire revenue engine, from finding the right accounts to closing and growing them. Revenue teams today juggle 25+ disconnected tools. Kris@Work replaces them with a single system, powered by its proprietary Kris Tell Intelligence™ layer and a multi-agent architecture that thinks, decides, and acts across the revenue cycle.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a AI-native Product Manager who blends product thinking, data science rigor, and comes with hands-on AI fluency. This role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI-driven capabilities, ranging from predictive models to generative experiences, translating complex data & ML systems into scalable, customer-impacting products.

The ideal candidate has prior experience in data science or ML, deeply understands model behavior, trade-offs, and evaluation, and can partner seamlessly with engineering, ML, and business stakeholders to ship intelligent, impactful, reliable & explainable AI products.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & AI Vision**

* Define & own the AI product vision and roadmap, aligned with business outcomes and measurable customer value
* Identify high-leverage prediction and generation opportunities across user workflows
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear AI-powered product hypotheses
* Prioritize features using data, expected lift, confidence intervals & ROI modeling

**Predictive AI Ownership**

* Lead products powered by classification, regression, ranking, forecasting & anomaly detection models
* Define prediction targets, labels, features, and success criteria in collaboration with AI/ ML engineering teams
* Drive decisions around model refresh cadence, retraining triggers & drift detection

**Generative AI & LLM-Driven Experiences**

* Own GenAI use-cases including summarization, recommendations, copilots, content generation & reasoning workflows
* Design prompt strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-calling & memory architectures
* Balance determinism, creativity, latency & cost across GenAI experiences
* Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI quality (faithfulness, relevance, completeness, toxicity, hallucinations)

**Data-Driven Product Execution**

* Write clear, technical PRDs that include data inputs & outputs, model assumptions & constraints, evaluation metrics & guardrails, failure modes & fallback strategies
* Partner deeply with ML engineers to review feature pipelines, model choices & offline vs online evaluation results
* Make informed trade-offs between rules, heuristics, classical ML & LLMs

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* Design and own A/B tests, holdouts & phased rollouts for AI features
* Measure incremental impact, not just accuracy (conversion lift, time saved, win-rate, retention)
* Build feedback loops to improve models using human-in-the-loop signals
* Define north-star & secondary metrics for AI success

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the product glue between ML, engineering, design, sales, customer success & leadership
* Translate technical AI concepts into clear business narratives for executives
* Partner with go-to-market teams on AI positioning, trust messaging & explainability
* Influence without authority, and set direction through clarity & data

**AI Ethics, Trust & Reliability**

* Ensure responsible AI practices around bias detection & mitigation, explainability & transparency as well as privacy, data governance & compliance
* Define guardrails, confidence indicators, and override mechanisms for AI outputs
* Proactively identify edge cases and failure scenarios before customers do

**Who You Are & What Makes You Qualified**

* 4+ years of Product Management experience, with significant ownership of data and/or AI-powered products
* Proven track record shipping predictive models and/or GenAI products to production
* Strong understanding of supervised & unsupervised ML, feature engineering & data pipelines, model evaluation & experimentation
* Practical experience with LLMs (OpenAI/ Anthropic), RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering & evaluation
* Comfortable querying data (SQL) & reading Python notebooks
* Ability to reason about model performance, trade-offs & limitations
* Deep intuition for user workflows & decision-making under uncertainty
* Ability to connect model output to user action & business outcome
* Strong prioritization skills grounded in data, not intuition alone
* Experience building 0→1 AI products or scaling AI features across large user bases
* Experience with B2B SaaS, sales tech, CRM, or revenue intelligence platforms is preferred
* Prior hands-on experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Applied Scientist is preferred
* Exposure to real-time systems, streaming data, or low-latency inference
* Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated data
* Familiarity with AI infra tools (feature stores, model registries, monitoring)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management & executive-level presentation & delivery skills
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, AI or related discipline; advanced degree is preferred

You will partner closely with customers, support, QA, and the broader Product team to create Data Solutions for real-world addressing business challenges.

* Use AI tools to build and test prototype solutions to prioritized business problems
* Work closely with Sales Engineers to validate proposed solutions for field verified use cases
* Create detailed engineering requirements to convert prototypes into hardened products
* Perform industry and market research to stay informed of technological advancements in AI to identify revenue opportunity and to apply best practices to Precisely solutions
* Own and prioritize the backlog across multiple engineering teams, covering new features, enhancements to existing features. You will assist and advise the engineering team on their defects and technical debt considerations.
* Provide subject matter expertise to the support team as they handle customer escalations, this could be from initial triage on accounts through to engineering root-cause analysis, fix validation, and customer-facing resolution.
* Act as the technical bridge between Product, Engineering, QA, Support, and external customers – running weekly review calls and contributing to solution definition reviews.

----------------------------

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. * Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
* Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

* Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.

Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.

**About the team**

The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. jobs.description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the role**

  

The Control COE Lead is responsible for developing, governing, and continuously improving the enterprise-wide control framework within Digital & Technology. The role leads the design, simplification, automation, standardisation, and rationalisation of controls across D&T, ensuring the control environment is efficient, modern, risk‑based, and aligned to regulatory, audit, and operational expectations.

  

The role oversees the definition of control standards, patterns, and reusable frameworks and works with control owners, product teams, architects, engineering, and compliance stakeholders to embed high-quality, sustainable control designs. The Control COE Lead drives automation opportunities across the control lifecycle, including preventative controls, detective controls, continuous monitoring, and digital evidence collection.

  

As a central authority for control excellence, the role ensures alignment across SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity, privacy, GxP and other compliance domains, reducing duplication, improving efficiency, and enabling a scalable, tech‑enabled control environment.

  

**Role Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the enterprise-wide redesign, simplification, and optimisation of the D&T control environment, including control mapping, duplication elimination, standardisation, and creation of reusable design patterns.
* Define and maintain D&T control standards, methodologies, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity, and privacy control expectations.
* Drive automation of controls and evidence collection, partnering with engineering, automation teams, and GRC tooling teams to enable continuous monitoring, preventative controls, and tech‑enabled assurance
* Oversee the rationalisation of existing controls, including removal of redundant or ineffective controls, consolidation of overlapping controls, and replacement of manual processes with automated solutions.
* Provide expert advisory support to control owners, product teams, architects, and risk & compliance, ensuring new solutions and technology changes embed “compliance by design” and adopt approved control patterns.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the control lifecycle, measuring control effectiveness, identifying systemic issues, and coordinating enhancements with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.  

  

Business Expertise

  

* Requires deep understanding of technology risk, SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity control frameworks, and GxP expectations, including how these apply to modern cloud, data, infrastructure, and product environments.
* Strong knowledge of control design principles, process optimisation, automation capabilities, and industry best practices for controls engineering.
* Ability to translate regulatory requirements (SOx, GxP, privacy, cybersecurity) into actionable, scalable, technology‑friendly controls.

* Broad understanding of modern digital architecture (cloud, identity, data, DevOps), enabling effective collaboration with engineering and architecture teams on embedding automated controls.
Commercially aware with ability to prioritise control optimisation activities that drive the biggest impact on risk reduction, cost reduction, audit readiness, and operational efficiency.  

  

Problem Solving

  

* Tackles highly complex challenges relating to inconsistent control design, legacy processes, and fragmented control ownership across D&T.
* Requires ability to evaluate root causes, identify structural issues, and propose scalable and simplified solutions that balance risk, audit needs, regulatory expectations, and business agility.
* Must innovate by introducing automation, continuous monitoring, control-as-code, and modern assurance methods.
* Challenges compounded by evolving regulatory requirements (SOx, cybersecurity), continuous technology changes, and differing levels of maturity across teams.
Requires structured judgement to redesign controls that are both audit‑ready and aligned to modern technology delivery practices (agile, DevSecOps, product‑centric operating models).  

  

Interactions / Interpersonal Skills

  

* Extensive engagement with control owners, engineers, architects, product leaders, security teams, risk & compliance, internal audit, quality (for GxP systems), and external auditors.
* Requires strong communication and stakeholder management skills to explain complex control redesign concepts in clear, simple terms suitable for both technical and business audiences.
* Must influence decision-making without direct authority, particularly when simplifying long‑standing legacy control processes.
Skilled in negotiation, conflict resolution, and driving adoption of new standards across diverse teams and geographies.  

  

**Skills Qualifications**

  

* Degree or equivalent professional experience in Information Systems, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline
* At least 15+ years of experience in IT compliance, auditing, or risk management
* Experience in technology risk management, control design, or control operation…

You will work on credit risk engagements for GCC banks, including credit approval automation, rating and scoring models, IFRS 9 ECL and credit risk system implementations. •        Experience with SIT or UAT.

The DTC Customer Service team is part of the broader Direct To Consumer (DTC) team, which aligns with our corporate strategy of putting our customers and our direct relationships with our customers first. We strive to be a customer-centric division, using the latest technologies and innovations to serve our customers in a manner that is authentic with the brand values.
  
  
The Business Analyst in the DTC Customer Service team Team will play a pivotal role in an agile delivery environment, focusing on optimizing and enhancing Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities. This role involves partnering with business stakeholders, customer service teams, technology teams, and external vendors to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and ensure successful delivery of solutions that improve customer support operations and customer experience.

* Partner with Product Managers, Delivery Managers, and Customer Service Operations teams to capture, prioritize, and translate business requirements into actionable Salesforce Service Cloud solutions.

* Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to stakeholders, maintaining transparency throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide ongoing support and training to users on new systems and processes, ensuring adoption and continuous improvement.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for business processes, technical specifications, and system configurations.

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst for Salesforce Service Cloud solutions in an agile delivery environment.

* Understanding of integration technologies, APIs and enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of SQL and database management.

* Collaboration: Working effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.
* Adaptability: Being flexible and open to changes in a dynamic, agile environment.
* Problem-solving: Approaching challenges with a solution-oriented mindset.
* Attention to Detail: Ensuring accuracy and thoroughness in documentation and analysis.
* Time Management: Prioritising tasks and managing time efficiently to meet deadlines.
* Empathy: Understanding user needs and perspectives to create user-friendly solutions.
* Continuous Learning: Staying updated with the latest industry trends and technologies.
* Strategic Thinking: Aligning business analysis efforts with organisational goals and objectives.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

* Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist) are a plus.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in the retail, ecommerce or B2C industry, particularly within global customer service operations.
* Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional technology teams in front-end development or customer experience projects.
* Experience in analysing and mapping agent workflows, and familiarity with Contact Center technologies, CTI integrations, and AI-powered service capabilities.
